Contacts API Documentation

Welcome to Contacts API documentation!

This project provides an API for managing contacts and users.

Application Modules

CRUD Module

app.crud.create_contact(db: Session, contact: ContactCreate, user_id: int)

Create a new contact for a user.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • contact (ContactCreate) – Data for creating a contact.

  • user_id (int) – ID of the contact owner.

Повертає:

The created contact.

Тип повернення:

Contact

app.crud.delete_contact(db: Session, db_contact: Contact)

Delete a contact from the database.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • db_contact (Contact) – Contact to delete.

Повертає:

No value is returned.

Тип повернення:

None

app.crud.get_birthday_for_year(birthday: date, year: int) → date

Return a birthday date for the specified year.

Handles February 29 for years that are not leap years.

Параметри:

  • birthday (date) – Original birthday.

  • year (int) – Target year.

Повертає:

Birthday adjusted to the target year.

Тип повернення:

date

app.crud.get_contact(db: Session, contact_id: int, user_id: int)

Retrieve a contact by its ID for a specific user.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • contact_id (int) – ID of the contact.

  • user_id (int) – ID of the contact owner.

Повертає:

The contact if found, otherwise None.

Тип повернення:

Contact | None

app.crud.get_contacts(db: Session, user_id: int)

Retrieve all contacts belonging to a specific user.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • user_id (int) – ID of the user whose contacts are retrieved.

Повертає:

List of contacts belonging to the user.

Тип повернення:

list

app.crud.get_upcoming_birthdays(db: Session, user_id: int)

Retrieve contacts with birthdays within the next seven days.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • user_id (int) – ID of the user whose contacts are checked.

Повертає:

Contacts with upcoming birthdays.

Тип повернення:

list

app.crud.search_contacts(db: Session, query: str, user_id: int)

Search contacts by first name, last name or email.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • query (str) – Search string.

  • user_id (int) – ID of the user whose contacts are searched.

Повертає:

List of matching contacts.

Тип повернення:

list

app.crud.update_contact(db: Session, db_contact: Contact, contact: ContactUpdate)

Update an existing contact.

Параметри:

  • db (Session) – SQLAlchemy database session.

  • db_contact (Contact) – Existing database contact.

  • contact (ContactUpdate) – New contact data.

Повертає:

The updated contact.

Тип повернення:

Contact
